|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">１フォース使用し、任意の反乱軍かエイリアンに配備する。タトゥイーンにいる間、そのキャラクターの戦闘力と没収値に＋２。</span>
|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">サバイバル用の装備、食料、道具が細かく区分けされ収まっている。バンサの革製で、ルークや他のタトゥイーンの住人たちが使っている。</span>
|translation='''Title''' — [[Tatooine Utility Belt]].

'''Lore''' — Survival equipment, food, and tools are stored in small divided compartments. It is made of bantha hide and used by Luke and other Tatooine inhabitants.

'''Game text''' — Use 1 Force to deploy on any Rebel or alien. While that character is on Tatooine, that character's power and forfeit are +2.
|translation_note=Printed subtype is アイテム. Game text uses タトゥイーンにいる間 (while present on Tatooine) rather than “While on Tatooine”. White border, 1997 copyright.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-tatooineutilitybelt.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine Utility Belt]].</ref>
